## h12 — Dispatch: SQL INSERT for memo creation

**Answer:** `(*sqlite.DB).CreateMemo` — `/bench/home/work/store/db/sqlite/memo.go` (line 15); determination: the default driver is `"sqlite"` set via `viper.SetDefault("driver", "sqlite")` at `/bench/home/work/cmd/memos/main.go` line 122 (and the flag default at line 130), which causes `db.NewDBDriver` (in `/bench/home/work/store/db/db.go` line 14) to match the `"sqlite"` case at line 21, constructing `sqlite.NewDB`. The `store.Driver` interface (`/bench/home/work/store/driver.go` line 10) declares `CreateMemo`, and all three drivers (sqlite, mysql, postgres) implement it.
